newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand injects 3.0 bln baht into market.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand injects 3.0 bln baht into market.

text.p: Bank of Thailand governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Monday the central bank had injected a total of three billion baht into the system in the morning through its bond repurchase operation.
The BOT also sold $35 million to a commercial bank, Bangkok Bank of Commerce Plc, which the bank would use to repay its foreign loans, Rerngchai told reporters.

The Thai overnight interbank rate rose to 13.00-14.00 percent in afternoon trade from 11.00-11.50 percent late on Friday due to political concerns over the outcome of Sunday's general election, dealers said.
